lines.text: Dead quiet. Just me and the crickets.
Lock it! Please, hit the lock right now!
Whoa, hey, slow down! What's going on?
A guy in a black sedan followed me for three miles. He saw me run in here. Lock the door!
Okay, it's locked. You're safe. I'm calling nine one one.
Wait, you're good. A cop just pulled into the lot.
No. No, no, no. That's not a real cop.
Look at the roof. There's no unit number. He's the one who was chasing me.
Police! Open the door! Is there a girl in a grey hoodie in there?
Don't open it! Look at his belt. He doesn't even have a radio. If you unlock that door, we're both dead.
Sir, step away from her right now! She just attacked a clerk at the Shell station two miles up. She's armed!
It's just my house keys! Please, don't listen to him!
Holy crap. She's telling the truth.
One of them is lying. Or both of them are.
